Screen 15 · News Feed — Annotations
① EC Logo
The Escape Collective logo in the header signals the content source. White version used in dark mode, black version in light mode. Tapping could deep-link to escapecollective.com — TBD with product.
② Article Type Pills
Category tag pulled from the RSS item's category or tag field. Examples shown: Race Report, Feature (EC Orange text, no background). Daily News items use a filled orange pill (see annotation ④) to distinguish them as a product rather than a content category. Mapping from EC's taxonomy to pill labels to be defined at implementation.
③ Image vs Compact Cards
Cards with an article image (from RSS <media:content> or <enclosure>) display the image at the top. Articles without images fall back to a compact text-only layout. The feed naturally mixes both — no enforced uniformity needed.
④ Daily News Treatment
EC's Daily News items never carry a feature image — they previously blended indistinguishably with other compact cards.

Treatment: left EC Orange accent bar (4px, border-left: 4px solid var(--accent)) + subtle orange tint on the card background. The category pill uses a filled orange chip rather than the standard text-only label, reinforcing Daily News as a product name rather than a content category. No author line — Daily News is an EC publication, not a bylined article.

Implementation: Detect items tagged as Daily News in the RSS feed and apply the daily-news card class. No other layout changes needed.
⑤ Card Tap — Open in Browser
Tapping a card opens the full article in the user's default browser (Safari/Chrome). In-app browsers are not suitable here because much EC content is behind a paywall/registration wall, and in-app browser sessions are sandboxed — users would be logged out even if already authenticated in their regular browser.

Known issue for dev: A user authenticated in the fantasy app will not automatically be authenticated on escapecollective.com. SSO or a shared session token may be needed to avoid a second login prompt. Flag for developer resolution.
⑥ RSS Fields Used
Headline → title · Excerpt → description (truncated to 2 lines) · Author → dc:creator · Time → pubDate (relative, e.g. "2h ago") · Image → media:content or enclosure · Pill category → category.
